tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and have H≤0.48, far short of the target H=23.8. The probe near H=20 directly tests the predicted sign reversal and constrains the slow adaptation where it matters for the forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. Fits that agree on the pilot can disagree at H=23.8.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly test the late reversal.
It does not resolve the slow adaptation or the forecast sign.
